The Wizards defeated the Hornets, 95-79 tonight in Washington. Anthony Davis finished with a team-high 25 points along with 13 rebounds for the Wizards, while Trae Young tallied 21 points, 9 assists and 7 rebounds in the game. Brandon Miller recorded 19 points, 7 rebounds and 3 three pointers. The Wizards improve their record to 3-3 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 3-3 for the season.
